reviewed_contracts: One planner per UI controller; V1/V2 factory/version injection and immutable issued preview remain in that planner. Null-prototype empty choices work with prepareImport.

File size is checked before arrayBuffer; file reader must return an actual ArrayBuffer of exactly the selected physical size. Guard checked before read, immediately after await/rejection and before preview acceptance; catalog raw reread after await.
New file selection/cancel/query/owner/contract/mode/catalog changes invalidate the operation; stale completions release only their own ticket and cannot overwrite a newer operation/preview.

Confirmation prepares the complete catalog again, rereads planned.expectedRaw, then changed plans call the existing store.mutate once with immutable entries and the same guarded operation. Existing version-specific lock and final byteCAS/guard remain storage-owned.
No-op confirm rereads exact observed bytes but calls no storage write/lock. Exact whitespace/null raw bytes remain untouched.
Export validates a fresh catalog snapshot, creates the Blob, and checks exact raw bytes plus operation guard again before synchronous download; no storage mutation or implicit Apply.

Imported catalog metadata never calls hooks.apply or query mutation. Existing active-ID replacement/re-add compares a complete library.makeEntry of the actual working snapshot, including section/schema/filter/semantics/search/predicate/sort/projection; modified badge is derived from complete equality.

Dynamic conflict controls require connected DOM, current availability, exact import token and stamp; new controls replace old nodes. Copy UUID is stable while editing its name. File input clears for reselection; static binds check connected/current element and mode availability.
limitations: Source-only independent review; author75pure count is referenced by its existing raw-bound proof, not rerun by this reviewer.
No real browser Filechooser/read/download/DOM focus or native E2E execution is established here.
No real WebLock/quota/CAS/storage-event/cold/runtime result is established by this source review; those remain Root/native gates.
Own-data/file contracts are reviewed, not a sandbox against arbitrary JavaScript Proxy traps or malicious hook implementations.
No full regression, current publicCI, manufacturerparity or overall ui.filter-details-export completion claim.
